description: Returns the current drawing as JSON: its layers, shared colours, materials, dimension styles and nodes. Pass "ids" to get only those nodes, with everything inside the groups among them, or "container" (a page, component or group id) to get what it holds. Use it when the drawing was too large to include with the request, or to check the result of an edit.

container.description: Id of a page, component or group.

ids.description: Ids of the nodes to read.

name: read_document
